$description: Radius, elevation and control geometry. Every value is the one the dashboard already converged on — the counts are real usage, and the scale is deliberately short so there is no room to drift.

radius.$description: Named for the JOB, not a size step. Deliberately NOT sm/md/lg: Tailwind already owns those names with different values, and redefining them would silently resize every existing `rounded-lg` in a consuming app — 1,438 of them in the dashboard this was extracted from.

chip.$description: Chips, delta pills, tight icon buttons.

control.$description: The default: buttons, inputs, cards. 827 uses.

panel.$description: Panels, modals, the sidebar nav card. 161 uses.

sheet.$description: Top corners of the mobile bottom sheet.

full.$description: Avatars, badges, pills. 9999px rather than v4's calc(infinity * 1px) — same render, but only the finite value is portable outside Tailwind.

shadow.$description: Named for the job for the same reason as radius: Tailwind's `shadow-sm` means something different again in v4, and taking that name back would undo the v3->v4 rename.

raised.$description: Resting cards and the active nav item. 195 uses — the only elevation most screens need.

float.$description: Things that float over the page on demand — dropdowns, popovers, drawers.

overlay.$description: Modal panels only — the one surface that blocks the page behind it.

control.$description: Control heights. The same component takes the lg size below the sm breakpoint and md above it, so a 44px touch target needs no separate mobile component.

sm.$description: 32px — inside table rows and card footers.

md.$description: 36px — the default, at sm and up.

lg.$description: 44px — below sm, and the studio action bar.

fab.$description: 56px — the mobile floating action button. Larger than lg on purpose: it is the one control a thumb reaches for without looking, and it overlaps the bar rather than sitting in it.

space.$description: A 4px base scale. Named steps exist only where the system relies on a specific one.

page.$description: Content card padding at lg and up.
